CustomField.description: Populated by flow (SurveyResponse_Contact_UpdateMostRecentCSATScoreAndComments), when a Feedback Survey Response's CSAT Score Comments are created or updated, the CSAT Score Comments are stored in this field. Read Only to all but Admins (via profile) and Typeform Integration User (via permission set)

CustomField.label: Most Recent CSAT Score Comments
